title: Velocity Punish
description: A modern Velocity punishment system for Minecraft networks featuring configurable punishments, automatic escalation, Discord webhooks, MiniMessage support, MySQL, SQLite and professional moderation tools.
body:
# Punish Velocity

A modern, scalable and production-ready punishment system for Velocity networks.

SiuuuHD-Punish is designed for professional Minecraft servers and provides a clean moderation workflow with automatic punishments, escalation handling, full history tracking, and Discord integration.

---

## ✨ Features

- Velocity support  
- Minecraft 1.21+ compatibility  
- Java 21 requirement  
- MySQL / MariaDB / SQLite support  
- HikariCP connection pooling  
- LuckPerms integration  
- Adventure MiniMessage support  
- Discord webhook integration  
- Network-wide punishment handling  
- Offline player support  
- UUID-based data storage  
- Fully configurable system  
- Automatic punishment escalation  
- Staff notifications & alerts  
- Professional ban screens  
- Production-ready architecture  

---

## ⚖️ Punishment System

Simple and fast moderation:

/punish <player> <reason>

Example:
/punish Notch HACKING

Punishments are automatically applied based on configuration:

HACKING:
  type: BAN
  duration: 14d

No manual duration handling required.

---

## 🧾 Commands

/punish <player> <reason>
/pun <player> <reason>
/lookup <player>
/banlist
/punish reload

---

## 🔍 Player Lookup

Access detailed moderation data:

- Ban / Mute / Warn / Kick counts  
- Active punishments  
- Full punishment history  
- First & last join  
- Last seen status  
- Staff actions  

---

## 📈 Automatic Escalation

Progressive punishment system:

BELEIDIGUNG:
  type: MUTE
  escalation:
    - 1h
    - 6h
    - 1d
    - 7d

The system automatically increases punishment duration based on previous offenses.

---

## 💬 MiniMessage Support

Fully supports Adventure MiniMessage:

- Colors & gradients  
- Hover & click events  
- Advanced formatting  
- Fully customizable messages  

No hardcoded text.

---

## 🔗 Discord Integration

Staff Webhooks:
- Ban logs  
- Mute logs  
- Warn logs  
- Unban / unmute logs  

Public announcements:
- Ban announcements  
- Mute announcements  
- Security alerts  

---

## 🗄️ Database Support

- MySQL  
- MariaDB  
- SQLite  

All data is stored using UUIDs for maximum consistency.

---

## 🎮 Designed For

- Survival servers  
- Minigame networks  
- Practice servers  
- Large Velocity networks  
- Professional Minecraft communities  

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

- Velocity Proxy  
- Java 21  
- Minecraft 1.21+  

---

## 🚀 Why Punish Velocity?

Unlike traditional moderation plugins, Siuuuhd-Punish focuses on:

- Simplicity for staff  
- Automatic decision handling  
- High scalability  
- Clean configuration-based logic  

Staff only select a reason — everything else is handled automatically.
